title_tag: 以前靠du品赚钱，现在靠黄金：犯罪集团为什么突然盯上了金矿？—— 英国《卫报》外刊讲解第1185天
h1: 以前靠du品赚钱，现在靠黄金：犯罪集团为什么突然盯上了金矿？
category: 英国《卫报》外刊讲解 第1185天

headline.en_html: How gold <mark class="voc">surpassed</mark> cocaine as Peru’s most profitable criminal industry
headline.zh: 黄金如何超越可卡因，成为秘鲁最暴利的犯罪产业

notes.en: to be greater in amount, degree, or importance than something else
notes.ctx: 在利润上超过、盖过（指黄金带来的非法收益已超越可卡因贩运，成为秘鲁最暴利的犯罪产业）
notes.ex1: The company's annual revenue surpassed $10 billion for the first time in its history. 该公司年收入首次突破100亿美元大关。
notes.ex2: Her performance in the final exam surpassed everyone's expectations. 她在期末考试中的表现超出了所有人的预期。

paragraphs.en_html: “Halt, stop right there,” shouts a Peruvian Navy Seal, firing warning shots into the air. But the <mark class="voc">fleeing</mark> man pays no attention, <mark class="voc">scrambling up</mark> to the <mark class="voc">rim</mark> of a <mark class="voc">football pitch</mark>-sized <mark class="voc">crater</mark> and disappearing into the dense rainforest as the <mark class="voc">commandos</mark> <mark class="voc">give chase</mark>, <mark class="voc">swearing</mark> and shooting.
paragraphs.zh: “站住，不许动！”一名秘鲁海军陆战队队员高声喝道，朝空中鸣枪示警。然而，那名逃窜的男子充耳不闻，手脚并用地爬上一个足球场大小的坑洞边缘，转瞬消失在茂密的雨林中。突击队员们骂骂咧咧，一边开枪一边紧追不舍。

notes.en: running away from danger or a pursuer
notes.ctx: 正在逃窜的（描述那名不顾警告、拼命逃离抓捕的男子）
notes.ex1: Police finally caught the fleeing suspect after a three-hour chase. 经过三小时的追逐，警方终于抓住了那名逃窜的嫌疑人。
notes.ex2: Thousands of fleeing civilians crossed the border to seek refuge. 成千上万逃离的平民越过边境寻求避难。

notes.en: to climb or move up quickly and with difficulty, using both hands and feet
notes.zh: 攀爬而上，手脚并用地爬上
notes.ctx: 手脚并用地爬上坑洞边缘（形容逃窜者仓皇攀爬的狼狈姿态）
notes.ex1: The hikers scrambled up the rocky slope to reach the summit before sunset. 徒步者们手脚并用地爬上岩石斜坡，赶在日落前到达山顶。
notes.ex2: The children scrambled up the tree to get a better view of the parade. 孩子们手脚并用地爬上树，想更清楚地看游行。

notes.en: the outer edge of a circular or curved object
notes.ctx: 坑洞的边缘（指那个巨大矿坑的外沿）
notes.ex1: She stood at the rim of the Grand Canyon, speechless at the vastness before her. 她站在大峡谷的边缘，面对眼前的辽阔说不出话来。
notes.ex2: Coffee spilled over the rim of the cup onto the saucer. 咖啡从杯沿溢出，流到了碟子上。

notes.en: a field marked out for playing football; used as a unit of comparison for area
notes.ctx: 足球场（作为面积参照，形容矿坑之大，约相当于一个足球场的面积）
notes.ex1: The new sports complex covers an area equivalent to three football pitches. 这座新体育中心的面积相当于三个足球场。
notes.ex2: A crowd of fans invaded the football pitch after the final whistle. 终场哨响后，一群球迷涌入了足球场。

notes.en: a large bowl-shaped hole in the ground
notes.ctx: 矿坑（指非法采矿留下的大型坑洞，积满死水）
notes.ex1: The meteor impact left a massive crater in the middle of the desert. 陨石撞击在沙漠中央留下了一个巨大的坑洞。
notes.ex2: The road was closed after a crater appeared following heavy rains. 暴雨过后路面出现了一个坑洞，道路随即封闭。

notes.en: a soldier specially trained for making quick, surprise attacks
notes.ctx: 突击队员（指执行打击非法采矿任务的秘鲁海军陆战队特种兵）
notes.ex1: The commandos were dropped behind enemy lines under cover of darkness. 突击队员在夜色掩护下被空投到敌后。
notes.ex2: A team of commandos stormed the building and freed the hostages. 一队突击队员突袭了大楼，解救了人质。

notes.en: to run after someone or something in order to catch them
notes.ctx: 追捕（指突击队员对逃窜矿工的追击）
notes.ex1: The police gave chase on foot after the thief abandoned his car in the alley. 小偷在小巷里弃车而逃后，警察徒步追赶。
notes.ex2: The dog gave chase to the rabbit across the open field. 狗穿过开阔的田野追赶兔子。

notes.en: to use offensive language, especially because of anger
notes.ctx: 骂骂咧咧（形容突击队员在追捕过程中因恼怒而口出脏话）
notes.ex1: He stubbed his toe on the door and swore loudly. 他的脚趾撞到了门上，大声骂了一句。
notes.ex2: The driver swore under his breath when the car broke down again. 车又抛锚了，司机低声咒骂了一句。

paragraphs.en_html: Meanwhile, other marines set <mark class="voc">dynamite charges</mark> on a <mark class="voc">makeshift</mark> wooden raft that floats in the crater, which is essentially an enormous <mark class="voc">pit</mark> of <mark class="voc">opaque</mark>, <mark class="voc">stagnant</mark> water. The raft has a diesel-fuelled <mark class="voc">suction pump</mark> motor with thick plastic tubing used to <mark class="voc">suck up</mark> and <mark class="voc">sift through</mark> river sediment for tiny particles of gold. Soon after, a mushroom of orange and black fumes <mark class="voc">envelops</mark> the trees – and seconds later comes the sound of the explosion, <mark class="voc">shattering the peace of</mark> the Tambopata National Reserve, one of Peru’s most prized Amazon parks.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，其他海军陆战队员在一个漂浮于坑洞中的简易木筏上安放了炸药。这个坑洞实质上是一个巨大的、蓄满浑浊死水的深坑。木筏上装着一台燃柴油的抽吸泵，拖着粗大的塑料软管，用来抽取河底沉积物并从中筛滤出细微的金粒。片刻之后，一团橙黑色的蘑菇云吞没了四周的树木——紧接着传来一声爆炸巨响，打破了坦博帕塔国家保护区的宁静。这里是秘鲁最珍贵的亚马逊公园之一。

notes.en: an explosive device made with dynamite
notes.ctx: 炸药（指海军陆战队员安放在木筏上用于炸毁采矿设备的炸药）
notes.ex1: The construction crew used a dynamite charge to blast through the rock. 施工队用炸药炸开了岩石。
notes.ex2: Police discovered a dynamite charge hidden beneath the bridge. 警方发现桥下藏有一枚炸药装置。

notes.en: made quickly and used temporarily because nothing better is available
notes.ctx: 简易的（指矿工用木头临时搭建的木筏，简陋而粗糙）
notes.ex1: The refugees built a makeshift shelter out of plastic sheets and branches. 难民们用塑料布和树枝搭了一个临时住所。
notes.ex2: The hospital set up a makeshift ward in the parking lot after the earthquake. 地震后，医院在停车场搭起了一个临时病房。

notes.en: a large hole in the ground
notes.ctx: 矿坑（指非法采矿挖出的巨大水坑）
notes.ex1: The workers dug a deep pit to dispose of the waste. 工人们挖了一个深坑来处理废物。
notes.ex2: The children were warned not to go near the abandoned pit. 孩子们被警告不要靠近那个废弃的深坑。

notes.en: not able to be seen through; not transparent
notes.ctx: 浑浊的（形容矿坑中的水因泥沙混杂而完全不透明）
notes.ex1: The lake water was opaque with mud after the storm. 暴风雨过后，湖水因泥沙而变得浑浊不堪。
notes.ex2: The bathroom window is made of opaque glass to ensure privacy. 浴室的窗户用的是不透明玻璃，以保护隐私。

notes.en: (of water) not flowing or moving, often resulting in a bad smell
notes.ctx: 死水般的（形容矿坑中积水不流动，成为一潭死水）
notes.ex1: Mosquitoes breed rapidly in stagnant water. 蚊子在死水中繁殖迅速。
notes.ex2: The stagnant pool behind the factory gave off a foul odor. 工厂后面的死水潭散发出恶臭。

notes.en: a pump that draws liquid or gas out of something by creating a vacuum
notes.ctx: 抽吸泵（指矿工用于抽取河底沉积物的柴油动力泵）
notes.ex1: The firefighters used a suction pump to remove water from the flooded basement. 消防员用抽吸泵将地下室里的积水抽走。
notes.ex2: The suction pump failed, and the mine began to flood. 抽吸泵出了故障，矿井开始进水。

notes.en: to draw liquid, gas, or other substance upward or inward
notes.ctx: 抽取（指用泵将河底含有金粒的沉积物吸上来）
notes.ex1: The vacuum cleaner sucks up dust and debris from the floor. 吸尘器将地板上的灰尘和碎屑吸走。
notes.ex2: The roots of the plant suck up water from deep in the soil. 植物的根系从土壤深处吸取水分。

notes.en: to examine something carefully in order to separate what is wanted from what is not
notes.ctx: 筛滤（指从河底沉积物中筛出细微的金粒）
notes.ex1: The archaeologists sifted through the soil for fragments of pottery. 考古学家在土壤中仔细筛找陶器碎片。
notes.ex2: She sifted through hundreds of applications to find the right candidate. 她仔细翻查了数百份申请，以找到合适的人选。

notes.en: to cover or surround something completely
notes.ctx: 吞没、笼罩（指爆炸后的橙黑色浓烟将树木完全包裹）
notes.ex1: A thick fog enveloped the entire village at dawn. 黎明时分，浓雾笼罩了整个村庄。
notes.ex2: She was enveloped in a warm blanket by the fireplace. 她在壁炉旁被一条温暖的毯子裹着。

notes.en: to violently break the quiet and calm of a place
notes.ctx: 打破……的宁静（指爆炸声打破了坦博帕塔国家保护区的静谧）
notes.ex1: The sound of gunfire shattered the peace of the sleepy town. 枪声打破了这座宁静小镇的安宁。
notes.ex2: A sudden scream shattered the peace of the quiet library. 一声突如其来的尖叫打破了图书馆的宁静。

paragraphs.en_html: In total, more than 140,000 hectares have been lost to mining in Madre de Dios – a shocking 97.5% of the total <mark class="voc">deforestation</mark> caused by mining in Peru’s Amazon rainforest, an area twice the size of the US state of California.
paragraphs.zh: 在马德雷德迪奥斯地区，因采矿而丧失的土地总面积已超过14万公顷——占秘鲁亚马逊雨林采矿毁林总量的97.5%，触目惊心。这片面积相当于美国加利福尼亚州的两倍。

notes.en: the cutting down or removal of forests over a large area
notes.ctx: 毁林（指非法采矿导致的大面积雨林被砍伐破坏）
notes.ex1: Deforestation in the Amazon has reached alarming levels in recent years. 近年来，亚马逊地区的毁林速度已达到令人震惊的程度。
notes.ex2: The government launched a campaign to combat illegal deforestation. 政府发起了一场打击非法毁林的运动。

paragraphs.en_html: Military <mark class="voc">crackdowns</mark> on illegal mining in the Amazon are not new in Peru. But the <mark class="voc">skyrocketing</mark> international price of gold has caused this destructive activity to spread, empowering local gangs and attracting transnational organised crime. “Dirty” gold has become the country’s most profitable <mark class="voc">illicit</mark> industry, even surpassing drug <mark class="voc">trafficking</mark> in the world’s second-biggest producer of cocaine after Colombia. “Gold prices have risen,” said Gen Víctor Cotrina, the military commander of Madre de Dios, who is leading the crackdown on illegal gold mining. “That’s why, if a miner’s motor is destroyed, he’ll replace it quickly because gold is at its peak price; the very next day he’s back to his mining activities. He’s back at work again.”
paragraphs.zh: 秘鲁在亚马逊地区对非法采矿实施军事打击，并非新鲜事。但国际金价的飙升使这一破坏性活动不断蔓延，壮大了当地黑帮的势力，也吸引了跨国有组织犯罪集团。“脏金”已成为该国最暴利的非法产业，甚至超过了毒品走私——而秘鲁是全球第二大可卡因生产国，仅次于哥伦比亚。“金价涨了，”马德雷德迪奥斯军区司令维克托·科特里纳将军说，他正领导打击非法采金的行动。“所以，如果一个矿工的机器被毁了，他会很快再买一台，因为金价正处于巅峰。第二天他就回去接着干了。他又开工了。”

notes.en: severe action taken to restrict or punish a particular activity
notes.ctx: 打击行动（指秘鲁军方对非法采矿的军事打击）
notes.ex1: The government announced a crackdown on tax evasion. 政府宣布对逃税行为进行严厉打击。
notes.ex2: The police crackdown on illegal gambling led to dozens of arrests. 警方对非法赌博的打击导致数十人被捕。

notes.en: rising very quickly to a very high level
notes.ctx: 飞涨的（形容国际金价急剧攀升，助长了非法采矿的蔓延）
notes.ex1: Skyrocketing housing prices have made it impossible for young people to buy homes. 飞涨的房价使年轻人无法购房。
notes.ex2: The skyrocketing cost of healthcare is a major concern for many families. 医疗费用的飙升是许多家庭的主要忧虑。

notes.en: not allowed by law; illegal
notes.ctx: 非法的（指“脏金”已成为秘鲁最暴利的非法产业）
notes.ex1: The police seized a large quantity of illicit goods at the border. 警方在边境查获了大量非法货物。
notes.ex2: He was arrested for his involvement in illicit drug trade. 他因参与非法毒品交易而被捕。

notes.en: the illegal buying and selling of goods, especially drugs or people
notes.ctx: 贩运（指毒品走私，黄金的非法利润已超过毒品贩运）
notes.ex1: International cooperation is essential to combat human trafficking. 打击人口贩运需要国际合作。
notes.ex2: The gang was involved in drug trafficking across several countries. 该团伙参与了跨多国的毒品贩运。

paragraphs.en_html: For troops used to <mark class="voc">combating</mark> drug trafficking by targeting well-hidden <mark class="voc">plantations</mark> of coca, which is used to make cocaine, the fight against illegal gold presents new challenges as the end product is not an illicit drug but a legally traded commodity, Cotrina said. “The difference is that an <mark class="voc">open-pit</mark> mining operation doesn’t require <mark class="voc">covert</mark> operations, whereas drug trafficking does.” He said previous anti-mining crackdowns had been ineffective due to corruption and <mark class="voc">patchy</mark> enforcement. But now, with “<mark class="voc">aerial</mark> surveillance and military personnel who are available 24/7 to conduct patrols, we are determined to eliminate mining in this region”.
paragraphs.zh: 科特里纳说，对于习惯以隐蔽的古柯种植园为打击目标来缉毒的部队而言，打击非法采金带来了全新的挑战，因为其最终产品不是违禁毒品，而是一种合法交易的商品。“区别在于，露天采矿不需要秘密行动，而贩毒则需要。”他说，此前的反采矿行动因腐败和执法不力而收效甚微。但现在，凭借“空中侦察和全天候待命执行巡逻的军事人员，我们决心彻底根除这一地区的采矿活动”。

notes.en: to try to stop or prevent something bad from happening
notes.ctx: 打击（指部队习惯于通过打击古柯种植园来缉毒）
notes.ex1: The government has pledged more resources to combat climate change. 政府承诺投入更多资源应对气候变化。
notes.ex2: New measures were introduced to combat cybercrime. 出台了新措施以打击网络犯罪。

notes.en: a large area of land where crops are grown, especially in tropical countries
notes.ctx: 种植园（指用于制造可卡因的古柯种植园，通常隐蔽在丛林中）
notes.ex1: Thousands of workers were employed on the banana plantation. 数千名工人受雇于香蕉种植园。
notes.ex2: The coffee plantation stretches across the hillside. 咖啡种植园绵延整个山坡。

notes.en: relating to a type of mining in which the surface of the ground is excavated
notes.ctx: 露天开采的（指非法采金为露天作业，无需像贩毒那样隐蔽）
notes.ex1: The open-pit mine has scarred the landscape for miles around. 露天矿在周围数英里的地貌上留下了疤痕。
notes.ex2: Open-pit mining is cheaper but far more damaging to the environment. 露天采矿成本更低，但对环境的破坏要大得多。

notes.en: not done openly; secret or hidden
notes.ctx: 隐蔽的（指贩毒需要秘密进行，而露天采矿则不需要）
notes.ex1: The agency carried out a covert operation to gather intelligence. 该机构执行了一次秘密行动以收集情报。
notes.ex2: He was accused of making covert payments to government officials. 他被指控向政府官员秘密付款。

notes.en: not complete or consistent; happening in some places but not others
notes.ctx: 时断时续的、不到位的（指执法不力，打击行动零散而不彻底）
notes.ex1: The rainfall has been patchy this season, with some areas receiving none at all. 这个季节降雨分布不均，有些地区完全没有降雨。
notes.ex2: Her attendance at school was patchy due to frequent illness. 由于经常生病，她上学的出勤时断时续。

notes.en: relating to the air or done from the air
notes.ctx: 空中的（指利用空中侦察来监控非法采矿活动）
notes.ex1: Aerial photographs revealed the extent of the flood damage. 航拍照片揭示了洪灾的破坏程度。
notes.ex2: The military conducted aerial surveillance along the border. 军方沿边境进行了空中侦察。

paragraphs.en_html: The evidence is not difficult to find or destroy. Behind the wall of green that marks the edge of the reserve, troops and environmental <mark class="voc">prosecutors</mark> set <mark class="voc">ablaze</mark> a network of well-supplied mining camps, built with <mark class="voc">timber</mark> and blue <mark class="voc">tarpaulins</mark> and stocked with food and beer. A lone <mark class="voc">cockerel</mark> <mark class="voc">crows</mark> as the abandoned camps go up in flames.
paragraphs.zh: 证据并不难找到，也不难销毁。在标记保护区边缘的那道绿色屏障之后，军人和环保检察官放火焚烧了一片补给充足的采矿营地。这些营地用木材和蓝色防水布搭建，囤积着食物和啤酒。当被遗弃的营地燃起熊熊大火时，一只孤零零的公鸡发出了啼鸣。

notes.en: a lawyer who represents the government in criminal cases
notes.ctx: 检察官（指随军行动、负责环境犯罪起诉的环保检察官）
notes.ex1: The prosecutor presented new evidence to the court. 检察官向法庭提交了新证据。
notes.ex2: The prosecutor decided to drop the charges due to lack of evidence. 由于证据不足，检察官决定撤销指控。

notes.en: burning strongly
notes.ctx: 熊熊燃烧（指采矿营地在士兵点火后猛烈燃烧）
notes.ex1: The warehouse was ablaze before firefighters arrived. 消防员赶到时，仓库已燃起大火。
notes.ex2: Within minutes, the dry grassland was ablaze. 几分钟之内，干燥的草地就烧了起来。

notes.en: wood used for building or construction
notes.ctx: 木材（指搭建采矿营地所用的木料）
notes.ex1: The cabin was built from locally sourced timber. 小屋是用当地木材建造的。
notes.ex2: The old bridge was supported by massive timber beams. 这座老桥由巨大的木梁支撑。

notes.en: a large sheet of heavy waterproof material used as a cover
notes.ctx: 防水布（指矿工用蓝色防水布搭盖营地）
notes.ex1: They covered the woodpile with a tarpaulin to keep it dry. 他们用防水布盖住木柴堆，以防受潮。
notes.ex2: The refugees slept under a makeshift tarpaulin shelter. 难民们睡在临时搭建的防水布棚下。

notes.en: a young male chicken
notes.ctx: 公鸡（一只被遗弃的公鸡在营地燃烧时啼叫，画面凄清）
notes.ex1: The cockerel crowed at dawn, waking the entire farm. 公鸡在黎明时啼叫，叫醒了整个农场。
notes.ex2: They kept a cockerel and several hens in the backyard. 他们在后院养了一只公鸡和几只母鸡。

notes.en: (of a rooster) to make a loud, high-pitched sound
notes.ctx: 啼鸣（那只没被带走的公鸡在燃烧的营地旁啼叫，与火光形成强烈对比）
notes.ex1: The rooster crows every morning at sunrise. 公鸡每天日出时啼叫。
notes.ex2: We were woken by a rooster crowing outside our window. 我们被窗外啼叫的公鸡吵醒了。

paragraphs.en_html: Two women had been left behind by the fleeing miners: Andrea, 30, <mark class="voc">wept</mark> as she begged the officers not to arrest her, explaining she was a single mother who had been working as a cook and could find no other work to support a sick mother and two children. Liz Compi, 20, was found sitting on a boat with her one-year-old son. She said she had taken the job as a cook for $450 a month after being abandoned by her partner and <mark class="voc">sacked</mark> from a previous job.
paragraphs.zh: 逃离的矿工留下了两名女性：30岁的安德烈娅泪流满面，恳求军官不要逮捕她，解释说自己是个单亲母亲，一直做厨娘，找不到其他工作来养活生病的母亲和两个孩子。20岁的莉兹·孔皮被发现在一艘船上，身旁坐着她一岁的儿子。她说，在被伴侣抛弃、又被上一份工作解雇后，她以每月450美元的报酬接受了这份厨娘的工作。

notes.en: to cry tears, usually because of sadness or distress
notes.ctx: 哭泣（指安德烈娅哀求军官不要逮捕她时泪流满面）
notes.ex1: She wept with relief when she heard her son was safe. 听到儿子平安的消息，她如释重负地哭了。
notes.ex2: The mourners wept as the coffin was lowered into the ground. 灵柩下葬时，送葬者们失声痛哭。

notes.en: to dismiss someone from their job
notes.ctx: 被解雇（指莉兹在被伴侣抛弃后又被上一份工作辞退）
notes.ex1: He was sacked for repeatedly arriving late to work. 他因屡次上班迟到而被解雇。
notes.ex2: The manager was sacked after the company lost its biggest client. 公司失去最大客户后，经理被解雇了。

paragraphs.en_html: The dirty gold <mark class="voc">departs</mark> Peru as <mark class="voc">contraband</mark> to Bolivia and Brazil, but much of it is <mark class="voc">laundered</mark> into the legal trade via a controversial registration system called Reinfo. The system, in theory, should bring informal miners into the legal economy, but critics say it allows them to continue working without environmental permits and laundering illegal gold through formal companies. The trade is so <mark class="voc">lucrative</mark> that members of Congress have backed five repeated extensions of Reinfo, despite pushes to reform or eliminate the registry.
paragraphs.zh: 脏金以走私方式从秘鲁流向玻利维亚和巴西，但其中很大一部分通过一个有争议的登记制度——Reinfo——洗白进入合法贸易。该制度理论上应将非正规矿工纳入合法经济，但批评者指出，它允许矿工在没有环境许可的情况下继续作业，并通过正规公司将非法黄金洗白。这门生意利润太过丰厚，以至于尽管有改革或废除该登记制度的呼声，国会议员仍五次支持延长Reinfo。

notes.en: to leave a place, especially to start a journey
notes.ctx: 流出、离境（指脏金以走私方式从秘鲁流向玻利维亚和巴西）
notes.ex1: The train departs from platform three at 9 a.m. sharp. 列车于上午9点整从三号站台发车。
notes.ex2: She departed for Paris without saying goodbye to anyone. 她没有和任何人告别就动身去了巴黎。

notes.en: goods that are illegally imported or exported
notes.ctx: 走私品（指脏金作为走私货物从秘鲁运出）
notes.ex1: Customs officers seized contraband worth millions of dollars. 海关官员查获了价值数百万美元的走私品。
notes.ex2: The prisoners smuggled contraband into the jail hidden in food packages. 囚犯将违禁品藏在食品包装中偷运进监狱。

notes.en: to move money obtained illegally through legal businesses to hide its origin
notes.ctx: 洗白（指非法黄金通过正规公司被洗白进入合法贸易）
notes.ex1: The gang used a chain of restaurants to launder their drug money. 该团伙利用连锁餐厅洗白贩毒所得。
notes.ex2: He was convicted of helping to launder millions of dollars through offshore accounts. 他因协助通过离岸账户洗白数百万美元而被定罪。

notes.en: producing a great deal of profit
notes.ctx: 暴利的（指脏金贸易利润极其丰厚，以至于议员多次支持延长Reinfo制度）
notes.ex1: Consulting turned out to be a highly lucrative career for her. 事实证明，咨询业对她而言是一份收入极高的职业。
notes.ex2: The company signed a lucrative contract with a major retailer. 公司与一家大型零售商签订了一份利润丰厚的合同。

paragraphs.en_html: Since the beginning of Covid-19 pandemic, the price of gold has tripled. Tens of thousands of miners have <mark class="voc">poured into</mark> protected Amazon parks and <mark class="voc">Indigenous</mark> reserves, <mark class="voc">stripping away</mark> vast tracts of rainforest and leaving behind a <mark class="voc">denuded</mark>, <mark class="voc">pocked</mark> terrain, stagnant pools and disrupted river courses. Mercury is the cheapest and easiest way to extract gold because it <mark class="voc">binds with</mark> the particles in the river sediment. “The government’s response is moving very slowly,” said Flores after another day of relatively <mark class="voc">fruitless</mark> jungle raids, destroying camps that are likely to <mark class="voc">spring back</mark> up soon after. “Meanwhile, illegal mining operates 24 hours a day. The miners measure time in grams, not minutes, so we need to rethink how we investigate mining,” he said.
paragraphs.zh: 自新冠疫情暴发以来，金价已涨至原来的三倍。数以万计的矿工涌入亚马逊保护区和原住民保留地，大片雨林被剥除，留下的是一片光秃秃、坑坑洼洼的地表、死水潭和被改道的河流。汞是提取黄金最廉价、最简便的方法，因为它能与河底沉积物中的颗粒结合。“政府的反应非常缓慢，”弗洛雷斯在又一天收效甚微的丛林突袭后说道。他们捣毁的营地很可能不久后就会死灰复燃。“与此同时，非法采矿一天24小时不停运转。矿工用克来衡量时间，而不是用分钟，所以我们需要重新思考调查采矿的方式，”他说。

notes.en: to enter a place in large numbers or quantities
notes.ctx: 涌入（指疫情以来数以万计的矿工涌入亚马逊保护区和原住民保留地）
notes.ex1: Thousands of fans poured into the stadium before the match. 比赛前，成千上万的球迷涌入体育场。
notes.ex2: Foreign investment poured into the country after the reforms. 改革后，外资涌入该国。

notes.en: belonging naturally to a particular place; native
notes.ctx: 原住民的（指矿工侵入原住民保留地，破坏其家园）
notes.ex1: The museum is dedicated to preserving indigenous culture and traditions. 这座博物馆致力于保护原住民文化和传统。
notes.ex2: Indigenous communities have lived in these forests for thousands of years. 原住民社区在这些森林中生活了数千年。

notes.en: to remove something completely, especially a layer or covering
notes.ctx: 剥除（指大片雨林被采矿活动彻底剥离破坏）
notes.ex1: The hurricane stripped away the roof tiles from dozens of houses. 飓风掀掉了数十栋房屋的屋顶瓦片。
notes.ex2: The new regulations strip away many of the protections previously enjoyed by workers. 新法规剥夺了工人此前享有的许多保障。

notes.en: stripped bare of covering; deprived of vegetation or resources
notes.ctx: 光秃秃的（指采矿后雨林被剥光，地表裸露）
notes.ex1: The hillsides were denuded of trees after years of logging. 经过多年的伐木，山坡上的树木已被砍伐殆尽。
notes.ex2: The land lay denuded and barren after the mining operation. 采矿作业后，土地变得光秃而贫瘠。

notes.en: marked with small holes or pits; covered with depressions
notes.zh: 坑坑洼洼的，布满凹坑的
notes.ctx: 坑坑洼洼的（指采矿后地表布满坑洞，满目疮痍）
notes.ex1: The surface of the moon is pocked with craters. 月球表面布满了陨石坑。
notes.ex2: The old road was pocked with potholes after the harsh winter. 严冬过后，这条老路坑坑洼洼，满是凹坑。

notes.en: to combine chemically with another substance
notes.ctx: 与……结合（指汞与河底沉积物中的金粒结合，从而提取黄金）
notes.ex1: The drug binds with specific receptors in the brain. 这种药物与大脑中的特定受体结合。
notes.ex2: Calcium binds with phosphate in the intestines, reducing its absorption. 钙在肠道中与磷酸盐结合，从而减少其吸收。

notes.en: producing no useful results; unsuccessful
notes.ctx: 收效甚微的（指突袭行动成果有限，营地很快会死灰复燃）
notes.ex1: Their efforts to find the missing hiker proved fruitless. 他们寻找失踪徒步者的努力最终徒劳无功。
notes.ex2: After hours of fruitless negotiations, the talks were suspended. 经过数小时毫无成果的谈判后，会谈暂停了。

notes.en: to return quickly to a previous position or state
notes.ctx: 死灰复燃（指被捣毁的采矿营地很快又会重新出现）
notes.ex1: The branch sprang back and hit him in the face. 树枝弹回来打在了他脸上。
notes.ex2: Small businesses tend to spring back quickly after a recession. 小企业往往在经济衰退后迅速恢复。

proper.name: Peruvian Navy Seal / 秘鲁海军海豹突击队
proper.def:
秘鲁武装力量中的精锐特种作战单位，隶属秘鲁海军，训练参照美国海军海豹突击队模式，承担反恐、缉毒、打击有组织犯罪及保护国家战略资源等任务。亚马孙地区河网密布，海军的机动部署能力强于陆军，因而被派去打击非法采矿。
本文中的意思：第 1 段开头喝令“站住”、朝空中鸣枪示警的就是这类受过丛林作战训练的精锐，他们正在矿坑边追捕逃跑的矿工。

proper.name: Tambopata National Reserve / 坦博帕塔国家保护区
proper.def:
位于秘鲁东南部马德雷德迪奥斯大区，面积约 27.4 万公顷，2000 年设立，记录有 600 多种鸟类、1200 种蝴蝶和大量濒危哺乳动物，是全球生物多样性最高的地区之一。保护区北界为马林诺夫斯基河，沿岸是生态旅游高端营地集中的区域。
本文中的意思：爆炸声打破的正是这片“秘鲁最珍贵的亚马孙公园之一”的宁静——非法采矿已经推进到保护区边缘。

proper.name: Diesel-fuelled suction pump / 柴油动力抽吸泵
proper.def:
非法采金的核心设备：柴油发动机接上粗大塑料软管，从河床或矿坑里抽取含金沉积物，一台泵全天候运转，一天能处理大量泥沙。它也是打击行动的首要目标，摧毁发动机被军方视为切断矿工经济命脉的有效手段。
本文中的意思：第 2 段木筏上那台“燃柴油的抽吸泵”，正是海军陆战队要炸掉的东西。

proper.name: Mercury amalgamation / 汞齐化法
proper.def:
从沉积物中提金最廉价、最简便的办法：汞与金粒结合成汞齐，再加热把汞蒸发掉，留下黄金。成本极低，是手工和小规模采金者的首选，但汞会污染水道、毒害野生动物，并沿食物链在人体内累积。
本文中的意思：第 9 段那句“汞是提取黄金最廉价、最简便的方法，因为它能与河底沉积物中的颗粒结合”，说的就是这套工艺。

proper.name: Madre de Dios / 马德雷德迪奥斯
proper.def:
秘鲁东南部大区，位于亚马孙雨林腹地，面积约 8.5 万平方公里，93% 被热带森林覆盖，被称为“生物多样性之都”，也是秘鲁非法采金活动的绝对中心。
本文中的意思：全文的地理坐标——这里的采矿毁林超过 14 万公顷，占秘鲁亚马孙采矿毁林总量的 97.5%。

proper.name: 97.5% deforestation ratio / 97.5% 毁林占比
proper.def:
指马德雷德迪奥斯的采矿毁林面积占秘鲁亚马孙雨林采矿毁林总量的比例。原文称这个数字“触目惊心”，意味着秘鲁亚马孙因采矿损失的森林几乎全部集中在一个大区。
本文中的意思：用来说明非法采金不是零星事件，而是一场高度集中的生态灾难。

proper.name: Global gold price surge / 国际金价飙升
proper.def:
原文提到，自新冠疫情暴发以来金价已涨至原来的三倍。金价越高，非法采金的利润越能覆盖被摧毁设备的成本，扩张就越快。
本文中的意思：科特里纳将军的解释——马达被炸，矿工第二天就换新的，因为“金价正处于巅峰”。

proper.name: Transnational organized crime / 跨国有组织犯罪
proper.def:
指跨国运作的有组织犯罪集团。与毒品不同，黄金是可以合法交易的商品，非法来源更容易借正规贸易渠道洗白，因此对跨国犯罪集团格外有吸引力。
本文中的意思：金价飙升“壮大了当地黑帮的势力，也吸引了跨国有组织犯罪集团”。

proper.name: Dirty gold / “脏金”
proper.def:
指通过非法手段开采、未经合法环境许可和纳税程序就进入市场的黄金。
本文中的意思：原文称“脏金”已成为秘鲁最暴利的非法产业，甚至超过了毒品走私。

proper.name: Peru as world's second-biggest cocaine producer / 秘鲁作为全球第二大可卡因生产国
proper.def:
原文明确提到秘鲁是“全球第二大可卡因生产国，仅次于哥伦比亚”。
本文中的意思：这层背景让“黄金超过可卡因”更有分量——在一个以可卡因为非法经济支柱的国家，黄金竟取代了它。

proper.name: Coca plantation / 古柯种植园
proper.def:
古柯是制造可卡因的原料植物，多种在隐蔽的丛林地块。打击古柯园需要情报渗透和秘密侦察。
本文中的意思：部队习惯了对付“隐蔽的古柯种植园”，而非法采金是完全不同性质的目标。

proper.name: Open-pit mining vs. covert drug trafficking / 露天采矿与隐蔽贩毒
proper.def:
科特里纳点出的核心差别：贩毒必须依赖秘密物流和隐蔽行动，露天采金却可以公开作业，传统缉毒执法模式因此很难照搬。
本文中的意思：原文用一句话概括——“露天采矿不需要秘密行动，而贩毒则需要”。

proper.name: Environmental prosecutor / 环保检察官
proper.def:
秘鲁公共部下设的专门检察官，负责调查和起诉非法伐木、非法采矿、野生动物贩运等环境犯罪。
本文中的意思：他们随军行动，参与烧毁采矿营地；文中出现的副检察官罗纳德·弗洛雷斯就是这类专业人员。

proper.name: Mining camp infrastructure / 采矿营地设施
proper.def:
原文写非法采金营地“补给充足”，用“木材和蓝色防水布搭建”，里头“囤积着食物和啤酒”。
本文中的意思：营地的完备程度说明非法采金高度组织化、长期化——矿工不是打一枪就走，而是建起能撑数月甚至数年的据点。

proper.name: Informal mining labor / 非正规采矿劳动力
proper.def:
非法采金吸纳大量边缘劳动力：单身母亲、被解雇的工人。文中两名女性——30 岁的安德烈娅和 20 岁的莉兹·孔皮——都在营地当厨娘，月薪约 450 美元。
本文中的意思：她们是采矿经济链条最底层、最脆弱的一环，也是执法现场最难处理的人。

proper.name: Reinfo / 矿业正规化综合登记制度
proper.def:
全称“Registro Integral de Formalización Minera”。原文称它是“一个有争议的登记制度”：理论上应把非正规矿工纳入合法经济，批评者却说它让矿工在没有环境许可的情况下照旧作业，还能通过正规公司洗白非法黄金。该制度已被五次延长。
本文中的意思：脏金从走私品变成“合法”黄金的关键通道。

proper.name: Gold laundering mechanism / 黄金洗白机制
proper.def:
逻辑很简单：矿工借正规公司出口黄金，来源就被掩盖了。
本文中的意思：原文说脏金“通过一个有争议的登记制度——Reinfo——洗白进入合法贸易”，由此进入全球市场。

proper.name: Indigenous reserves / 原住民保留地
proper.def:
秘鲁亚马孙地区受法律保护的土著社区土地。
本文中的意思：疫情以来数以万计的矿工涌入“保护区与原住民保留地”，大片雨林被剥除。

proper.name: Mercury contamination and bioaccumulation / 汞污染与生物累积
proper.def:
汞在环境中不会降解，排入水体后被细菌转化为甲基汞，沿食物链逐级富集，最终进入吃鱼的人体。原文没有展开后果，只点了一句提金用汞。
本文中的意思：这句轻描淡写背后，是非法采金最难逆转的环境代价。

proper.name: Denuded and pocked landscape / 裸露与坑洼地貌
proper.def:
雨林被剥离后留下裸露土地，地表布满矿坑和积水潭，河道被改道。这样的地貌既丧失原有生态功能，又造出蚊虫滋生的死水潭。
本文中的意思：原文用“光秃秃、坑坑洼洼的地表、死水潭和被改道的河流”一句写完了这场破坏。

proper.name: Fruitless raids and rapid recovery / 徒劳的突袭与迅速恢复
proper.def:
原文结尾，弗洛雷斯在又一天“收效甚微的丛林突袭”后说，政府反应很慢，而非法采矿 24 小时不停；被捣毁的营地“很可能不久后就会死灰复燃”。
本文中的意思：这就是打击非法采金的核心困境——执法零散而缓慢，采矿全天候运转。

sources_note: 资料核对：以上背景依据文章内容，并参考《卫报》关于秘鲁非法采金的系列报道、秘鲁海军与 SERNANP 公开资料、Reinfo 制度相关公开信息及 Global Witness 截至 2026 年 10 月的公开数据。

practice.intro: 请根据今天学习的外刊，把下面的中文句子翻译成英文。要求：尽量用上本文的核心表达，可以适当改变词形，但不要直接照抄原文。
items: 这家科技公司的年收入超过了所有竞争对手，成为行业第一。
孩子们手脚并用地爬上那棵大树，想摘到最高的果子。
地震后，灾民们用木板和塑料布搭了一个临时住所。
政府承诺加大对网络诈骗的打击力度，保护老百姓的钱袋子。
近年来，这座城市的房价飞涨，年轻人越来越买不起房。
尽管医生们努力抢救了整整一夜，但最终还是徒劳无功。
practice.critical_en: If illegal mining poisons rivers and clears rainforest but feeds families with no other income, who should bear the cost of stopping it?
practice.critical_zh: 如果非法采金毒害河流、毁掉雨林，却养活着一群别无生计的家庭，那么叫停它的代价该由谁来承担？
practice.answer:
1. The tech company’s annual revenue surpassed all its competitors, making it the industry leader.

2. The children scrambled up the big tree, hoping to pick the fruit at the very top.

3. After the earthquake, the victims built a makeshift shelter out of wooden boards and plastic sheets.

4. The government pledged to intensify its crackdown on online fraud to protect people’s savings.

5. In recent years, housing prices in this city have skyrocketed, making it increasingly hard for young people to afford a home.

6. Although the doctors fought to save him all night, their efforts ultimately proved fruitless.

mindmap.aria: 秘鲁非法采金文章思维导图

mindmap.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 960 720" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="秘鲁非法采金文章思维导图" style="width:100%;height:auto;font-family:-apple-system,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif">
        <rect x="24" y="306" width="176" height="88" rx="14" fill="#eae3d2" stroke="#9a8f76"/>
        <text x="112" y="342" text-anchor="middle" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="17" font-weight="700">亚马孙非法采金</text>
        <text x="112" y="368" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5c5648" font-size="12.5">黄金如何取代可卡因</text>

        <path d="M200,350 C232,350 232,88 260,88"  stroke="#6b8f71" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
        <path d="M200,350 C232,350 232,238 260,238" stroke="#7d98ad" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
        <path d="M200,350 C232,350 232,433 260,433" stroke="#bd7a6d" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
        <path d="M200,350 C232,350 232,628 260,628" stroke="#9b86b3" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>

        <g class="mm-branch" data-target="bc1">
          <rect x="260" y="71" width="190" height="34" rx="8" fill="#e6efe7" stroke="#6b8f71"/>
          <text x="349" y="93" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4c6b52" font-size="15" font-weight="700">突袭矿坑现场（¶1–2）</text>
          <text class="mm-arrow" data-for="bc1" x="442" y="93" text-anchor="end" fill="#4c6b52">▾</text>
        </g>
        <g class="mm-children" id="bc1">
          <path d="M450,88 C462,88 462,46 480,46" stroke="#6b8f71" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M450,88 C462,88 462,88 480,88" stroke="#6b8f71" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M450,88 C462,88 462,130 480,130" stroke="#6b8f71" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <rect x="480" y="30" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#e6efe7"/><text x="492" y="51" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">海军陆战队鸣枪追人，随后在木筏上安放炸药</text>
          <rect x="480" y="72" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#e6efe7"/><text x="492" y="93" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">足球场大的矿坑＝一潭浑浊死水，漂着抽吸泵木筏</text>
          <rect x="480" y="114" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#e6efe7"/><text x="492" y="135" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">爆炸升起橙黑蘑菇云，坦博帕塔保护区不再安静</text>
        </g>

        <g class="mm-branch" data-target="bc2">
          <rect x="260" y="221" width="190" height="34" rx="8" fill="#e5edf4" stroke="#7d98ad"/>
          <text x="349" y="243" text-anchor="middle" fill="#3d5872" font-size="15" font-weight="700">金价胜过可卡因（¶3–4）</text>
          <text class="mm-arrow" data-for="bc2" x="442" y="243" text-anchor="end" fill="#3d5872">▾</text>
        </g>
        <g class="mm-children" id="bc2">
          <path d="M450,238 C462,238 462,196 480,196" stroke="#7d98ad" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M450,238 C462,238 462,238 480,238" stroke="#7d98ad" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M450,238 C462,238 462,280 480,280" stroke="#7d98ad" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <rect x="480" y="180" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#e5edf4"/><text x="492" y="201" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">马德雷德迪奥斯：14 万公顷林地没了，占全国 97.5%</text>
          <rect x="480" y="222" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#e5edf4"/><text x="492" y="243" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">金价翻三倍，“脏金”利润反超毒品贩运</text>
          <rect x="480" y="264" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#e5edf4"/><text x="492" y="285" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">将军原话：马达炸了第二天就换，金价在顶峰</text>
        </g>

        <g class="mm-branch" data-target="bc3">
          <rect x="260" y="416" width="190" height="34" rx="8" fill="#f4e7e4" stroke="#bd7a6d"/>
          <text x="349" y="438" text-anchor="middle" fill="#7c4a3e" font-size="15" font-weight="700">为什么这么难打（¶5–7）</text>
          <text class="mm-arrow" data-for="bc3" x="442" y="438" text-anchor="end" fill="#7c4a3e">▾</text>
        </g>
        <g class="mm-children" id="bc3">
          <path d="M450,433 C462,433 462,391 480,391" stroke="#bd7a6d" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M450,433 C462,433 462,433 480,433" stroke="#bd7a6d" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M450,433 C462,433 462,475 480,475" stroke="#bd7a6d" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <rect x="480" y="375" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#f4e7e4"/><text x="492" y="396" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">露天作业无需隐蔽，缉毒那套打法用不上了</text>
          <rect x="480" y="417" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#f4e7e4"/><text x="492" y="438" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">空中侦察＋全天候巡逻，仍被腐败和零散执法拖住</text>
          <rect x="480" y="459" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#f4e7e4"/><text x="492" y="480" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">营地烧尽，留下一只公鸡和两个当厨娘的单亲母亲</text>
        </g>

        <g class="mm-branch" data-target="bc4">
          <rect x="260" y="611" width="190" height="34" rx="8" fill="#ece4f2" stroke="#9b86b3"/>
          <text x="349" y="633" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5a4670" font-size="15" font-weight="700">洗白与死循环（¶8–9）</text>
          <text class="mm-arrow" data-for="bc4" x="442" y="633" text-anchor="end" fill="#5a4670">▾</text>
        </g>
        <g class="mm-children" id="bc4">
          <path d="M450,628 C462,628 462,586 480,586" stroke="#9b86b3" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M450,628 C462,628 462,628 480,628" stroke="#9b86b3" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M450,628 C462,628 462,670 480,670" stroke="#9b86b3" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
          <rect x="480" y="570" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#ece4f2"/><text x="492" y="591" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">Reinfo 名义上扶正小矿工，实际给洗白开了口子</text>
          <rect x="480" y="612" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#ece4f2"/><text x="492" y="633" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">国会五次延长登记制度，因为这门生意太暴利</text>
          <rect x="480" y="654" width="456" height="32" rx="8" fill="#ece4f2"/><text x="492" y="675" fill="#3d3a34" font-size="14">矿工用克算时间，执法却慢半拍：营地烧完就重建</text>
        </g>
      </svg>
